label.description: The visible label, which also names the field. Without one, the field needs an aria-label or aria-labelledby, and an empty label does not count.

description.description: Supporting text shown with the field, which also describes it.

errorMessage.description: The message the field shows, in place of the built-in one, only while it is invalid, through the invalid prop or failed native, custom, or server validation. It never makes the field invalid by itself.

value.description: The number, when the caller controls it. NaN keeps the field empty.

defaultValue.description: The starting number, when the field controls itself.

disabled.description: Disables the field: it can be neither focused nor changed.

readOnly.description: Makes the field read-only: its number stays visible and focusable but cannot be changed.

required.description: Marks the field required, so a form with native validation does not submit while it is empty.

invalid.description: Marks the field invalid and shows its error message. Left false, validation decides, so failed native, custom, or server validation can still make the field invalid.

minValue.description: The smallest value. A typed value below it is raised to it when committed.

maxValue.description: The largest value. A typed value above it is lowered to it when committed.

step.description: How much the steppers and arrow keys change the value, and the step a typed value is rounded to when committed.

name.description: The form field name. A named field submits the plain number, or an empty string while it is empty.

formatOptions.description: How the number is shown, as Intl.NumberFormat options such as currency or percent. It changes only the displayed text: the field reports and submits plain numbers.

change.description: Called with the new number each time it is committed, and with NaN when the field is cleared.
